company.name: TransAstra
company.shortDescription: TransAstra develops a technology to find, prospect, harvest and use space resources.
company.description:
TransAstra is developing breakthrough technologies in the areas of space resources and in-space transportation to enable massive growth to existing space industries and whole new space industries. TransAstra leads the world in the technologies to find, prospect, harvest, and use space resources. Space resources include water and other valuable materials to be found on asteroids and lunar poles.

TransAstra knows how to extract these resources and use them as rocket propellant for use in today's commercial satellites and whole new industries including space tourism.

aiResearchSummary.text: TransAstra is researching systems and methods for radiant gas dynamic mining of permafrost, including the extraction of gas propellants from lunar and Martian polar regions, as described in 'Systems and methods for radiant gas dynamic mining of permafrost for propellant.' The company is also developing fabrication of ceramics from celestial materials using microwave sintering and manufacturing in space environments. These efforts focus on space resource prospecting, harvesting, and utilization.
